requirements.requirement: Membership and identity must be explicit, unique and bounded.
requirements.validation_plan: Duplicate/unknown identity, invalid threshold and role mask rejection.

requirements.requirement: Count only distinct accepted identities in one round/profile/policy/generation.
requirements.validation_plan: Duplicate, reordered, mismatched-context records cannot add votes.

requirements.requirement: Required role coverage is mandatory independently of count threshold.
requirements.validation_plan: Majority lacking required witness/control evidence denied.

requirements.requirement: Authentication, freshness and semantic acceptance remain separate upstream prerequisites.
Clock validity and bounded age must be checked at each assessment.
requirements.validation_plan: Timeout, rollback and overflow invalidate cached eligibility.

requirements.requirement: Accepted conflicting commitments or equivocation latch denial.
requirements.validation_plan: Witness conflict and majority agreement cannot clear latch.

requirements.requirement: Lost/asymmetric communication cannot establish complete evidence coverage.
requirements.validation_plan: Minority, majority and one-way partitions remain denied when predicates fail.

requirements.requirement: Reset, membership change and rejoin invalidate old-round evidence.
requirements.validation_plan: Stale restart and rejoin cannot reuse previous eligibility.

requirements.requirement: Reconciliation requires a separately verified scoped authority decision.
requirements.validation_plan: Unauthenticated clear, arbitrary boolean and automatic timeout cannot clear conflict.

requirements.requirement: Assessment, quorum and silence never grant actuation or failover.
requirements.validation_plan: Every state yields zero new actuator capability.

requirements.requirement: Malformed/replayed input preserves accepted evidence and freshness cursors.
requirements.validation_plan: Byte snapshots and follow-up valid record prove no consumption.

requirements.requirement: Evidence records retain context, identities, findings and recovery provenance.
requirements.validation_plan: Missing context and erased conflict history rejected; persistent integration pending.
